sentence: Indoda yam ivuka ngentsimbi yesine ukuze ikwazi ukufika emsebenzini kwangethuba.
translation: My husband gets up at four so that he can reach work in good time.

sentence: Kwintlanganiso yelali indoda endala yathetha yaza yathulisa wonke umntu.
translation: At the village meeting an old man spoke and hushed everyone.

sentence: Indoda enyanisekileyo ayithembisi into engenakuyenza, watsho utatomkhulu sihleli emlilweni.
translation: An honest man does not promise what he cannot do, my grandfather said as we sat by the fire.

sentence: Ndasitshisa isandla sam xa ndisusa imbiza emlilweni ngaphandle kwelaphu.
translation: I burned my hand taking the pot off the fire without a cloth.

sentence: Ndakufika, utatomkhulu wandolulela isandla, ndasibamba ngezandla zombini ngokuhlonipha.
translation: When I arrived, my grandfather held out his hand, and I took it respectfully with both of mine.

sentence: Isandla sam sasingcangcazela xa ndityikitya isivumelwano sokuqala somsebenzi.
translation: My hand was shaking as I signed my first work contract.

sentence: Emva kokubaleka ndisiya esitishini, intliziyo yam yabetha kabuhlungu esifubeni.
translation: After running to the station, my heart was pounding painfully in my chest.

sentence: Ugqirha wathi intliziyo katata ifuna ukuphumla, ke wayeka umsebenzi.
translation: The doctor said my father's heart needed rest, so he gave up his job.

sentence: Intliziyo yam yaphuka mhla umhlobo wam wemka esiya kuhlala eKapa.
translation: My heart broke the day my friend left to go and live in Cape Town.

sentence: Kumsitho wasekhaya, amadoda aba inyama ngokulingana kuzo zonke iintsapho.
translation: At a family ceremony the men share out the meat equally among all the households.

sentence: Amagosa karhulumente aba ukutya kwiilali ezibethwe yimbalela rhoqo ngenyanga.
translation: Government officials hand out food to the drought-stricken villages every month.

sentence: Amaxhego aba ilifa ngokwesiko, kodwa abazukulwana bakhalaza ngokungalingani.
translation: The elders divide up the inheritance according to custom, but the grandchildren complain that it is unequal.

sentence: Umoya wabetha ngamandla ebusuku, wawisa umthi omncinci egadini yethu.
translation: The wind blew hard during the night and knocked over the small tree in our garden.

sentence: Vula ifestile ukuze umoya ungene, kushushu kakhulu apha eklasini.
translation: Open the window so some air can get in — it is far too hot in this classroom.

sentence: Ndiyawuthanda umoya wolwandle kuba ususa lonke uxinzelelo lweveki.
translation: I love the sea air, because it carries off the whole week's stress.

sentence: Elo qanda olishiye etafileni libolile; ndiza kulilahla ngoku.
translation: That egg you left out on the table has gone off; I'm throwing it away now.

sentence: Elo hashe lomelele; utata ulisebenzisa ukutsala inqwelo yeenkuni.
translation: That horse is strong; my father uses it to pull the firewood cart.

sentence: Elo bali likamakhulu ndisalikhumbula, nangona wasweleka ndineminyaka esixhenxe.
translation: I still remember that story of my grandmother's, even though she died when I was seven.

sentence: Uyise kaThemba umphekela isidudu kwakusasa ngaphambi kokuba aye esikolweni.
translation: Themba's father cooks him porridge first thing in the morning, before he leaves for school.

sentence: Umfundi lo ufuna ukuba ngumqhubi kuba uyise waqhuba iteksi iminyaka engamashumi amabini.
translation: This student wants to be a driver because his father drove a taxi for twenty years.

sentence: Xa uyise engena endlwini, bonke abantwana bayathula baze bahlale phantsi.
translation: The moment their father walks into the house, all the children go quiet and sit down.

sentence: Musa ukungena ngezihlangu ezimdaka; ndigqibe ukuwucoca lo mgangatho.
translation: Don't come in with muddy shoes — I have just finished cleaning this floor.

sentence: Musa ukukhwela le teksi, umqhubi wayo uqhuba ngesantya esiphezulu.
translation: Don't get into that taxi — the driver of it goes much too fast.

sentence: Musa ukutyhafa ngenxa yamanqaku aphantsi; usenexesha lokuwalungisa ngaphambi kweholide.
translation: Don't lose heart over low marks; you still have time to pull them up before the holidays.

sentence: Amehlo kamakhulu awasaboni kakuhle; ndimfundela iileta zakhe ngokuhlwa.
translation: Grandmother's eyes no longer see well, so I read her letters to her in the evenings.

sentence: Ugqirha uthe mandiphumle, amehlo am adiniwe kukujonga ikhompyutha imini yonke.
translation: The doctor told me to rest — my eyes are worn out from staring at a computer all day.

sentence: Akathethanga nto, kodwa amehlo akhe andixelela ukuba akonwabanga.
translation: He said nothing, but his eyes told me that he was unhappy.

sentence: Emva kokutya, sonke sihlala phandle sisela iti sithetha ngemicimbi yosuku.
translation: After the meal we all sit outside drinking tea and talking over the day's business.

sentence: Utitshala uhamba-hamba emva kwabafundi ukuze abone ukuba akukho mntu okopayo.
translation: The teacher paces up and down behind the pupils so that he can see nobody is copying.

sentence: Ndakhala emva kokuva ezo ndaba, kodwa emva koko ndaziva ndikhululekile.
translation: I cried when I heard that news, but afterwards I felt a weight lift off me.

sentence: Umama uthumela abantwana ukuba bakhe amanzi emthonjeni kwakusasa.
translation: Mother sends the children to fetch water from the spring first thing in the morning.

sentence: Abasebenzi baseplasini basela amanzi abandayo emthunzini xa kutshisa emini.
translation: The farm workers drink cold water in the shade when the midday heat sets in.

sentence: Sikhalazela amanzi angcolileyo empompweni; ilali yonke ifuna impendulo kumasipala.
translation: We are complaining about the dirty water at the tap; the whole village wants an answer from the municipality.

sentence: Imifuno yasegadini yona iyakhula kakuhle, kodwa iitapile aziphumelelanga.
translation: The garden vegetables are doing fine, it's the potatoes that have failed.

sentence: Imisebenzi yasefektri yona iyafumaneka, kodwa umvuzo wayo awukwanelisi mntu.
translation: Factory jobs are easy enough to come by, but the pay they give satisfies nobody.

sentence: Utata wayityala le mithi ngo-1994; yona isaphila, nangona indlu ingasekho.
translation: Father planted these trees in 1994; they are still standing, even though the house is gone.

sentence: Umama uhamba ngebhasi, kodwa thina sikhwela iteksi ukuze sifike msinya.
translation: Mother travels by bus, but we take a taxi so that we get there quickly.

sentence: Thina esisebenza ebusuku siyagoduka kusasa, xa abanye besiya emsebenzini.
translation: Those of us who work nights head home in the morning, just as everyone else is going in.

sentence: Wonke umntu wathetha entlanganisweni, kodwa thina asizange sinikwe ithuba lokuphendula.
translation: Everybody else spoke at the meeting, but we were never given a chance to reply.

sentence: Umntwana wam ukhule kakhulu kulo nyaka; izihlangu zakhe azisamlingani.
translation: My child has grown so much this year that his shoes no longer fit him.

sentence: Isivuno sombona sancipha kakhulu kuba imvula ayizange ine ngoDisemba.
translation: The maize harvest came out far smaller, because no rain fell at all in December.

sentence: Ndamkhumbula kakhulu umakhulu ngeKrisimesi; kwakukho isithuba esikhulu etafileni.
translation: I missed my grandmother terribly at Christmas; there was a big empty space at the table.

sentence: Ezi zihlangu zombini zimanzi, zibeke ngaselangeni zome ngaphambi kokuya esikolweni.
translation: Both of these shoes are soaked — put them out in the sun to dry before school.

sentence: Ezi zicwangciso zokwakha iklinikhi zamkelwe ngabahlali bonke kwintlanganiso yayizolo.
translation: These plans to build a clinic were accepted by all the residents at yesterday's meeting.

sentence: Ezi ziqhamo zithengiswa ngasesitishini zibiza kakhulu, kodwa ndisazithenga rhoqo.
translation: This fruit they sell by the station is expensive, but I still buy it every time.

sentence: Apha endlwini kushushu kakhulu, masivule zonke iifestile nomnyango wangasemva.
translation: It is stifling in here — let's open all the windows and the back door.

sentence: Hlalani apha ngaphandle kwegumbi likagqirha, uza kunibiza ngamnye.
translation: Wait here outside the doctor's room; he will call you in one at a time.

sentence: Ndikhulele apha eMthatha, ngoko andifuni ukufudukela eKapa nokuba bandihlawula kangakanani.
translation: I grew up here in Mthatha, so I won't move to Cape Town no matter what they pay me.

sentence: Umkhonzi uvuka kwakusasa abase umlilo enkundleni phambi kokuba kuvuke wonke umntu.
translation: The servant rises at first light and lights the fire in the yard before anyone else is up.

sentence: Umkhonzi wathunywa emizini yonke ukuya kumema abantu emgidini wangomso.
translation: The servant was sent round every homestead to invite people to tomorrow's feast.

sentence: Umkhonzi othembekileyo akaphathwa njengesicaka, uphathwa njengelungu losapho.
translation: A faithful servant is not treated like a slave; he is treated as one of the family.

sentence: Ndandidla ngokupheka ngomlilo weenkuni, kodwa ngoku ndisebenzisa isitovu sikagesi.
translation: I used to cook over a wood fire, but now I use an electric stove.

sentence: Umphathi uthi masiphumle ngoku, siqhubeke nokulungisa uphahla emva kwesidlo sasemini.
translation: The foreman says we should take our break now and carry on with the roof after lunch.

sentence: Bendinexhala ixesha lonke, kodwa ngoku ndiziva ndikhululekile emva kweziphumo.
translation: I was anxious the whole time, but now that the results are out I feel relieved.

sentence: Umzi katatomkhulu useMqanduli, sikhwela iibhasi ezimbini ukuya khona ngeKrisimesi.
translation: My grandfather's homestead is at Mqanduli; we catch two buses to get there at Christmas.

sentence: Umzi ngamnye elalini unikele ngegusha yokwamkela abakhwetha ababuyayo entabeni.
translation: Every homestead in the village gave a sheep to welcome the initiates coming down from the mountain.

sentence: Ndikhumbula umzi wakowethu xa ndisiva ivumba lomlilo weenkuni ebusika.
translation: I ache for our homestead whenever I catch the smell of a wood fire in winter.

sentence: Ubuso bomntwana bugcwele udaka emva kokudlala ebaleni imini yonke.
translation: The child's face is caked with mud after playing out in the yard all day.

sentence: Ugqirha wajonga ubuso bam wandibuza ukuba ndagqibela nini ukulala kakuhle.
translation: The doctor looked at my face and asked when I had last slept properly.

sentence: Andisoze ndilibale ubuso bukamama mhla ndaphumelela ibanga leshumi.
translation: I will never forget my mother's face the day I passed matric.

sentence: Musani ukungena endlwini ninezihlangu ezinodaka, ndisandula ukutshayela igumbi lonke.
translation: Don't come into the house in muddy shoes — I have just swept the whole room.

sentence: Musani ukuchitha amanzi, impompo yaselalini ivaliwe kude kube ngoMvulo.
translation: Don't waste the water; the village tap is shut off until Monday.

sentence: Musani ukuphelelwa lithemba, sisenexesha lokuwubuyisa lo mdlalo.
translation: Don't lose heart, you lot — we still have time to turn this match around.

sentence: Ububi bendlela eya elalini benza iibhasi zingafiki ngexesha ebusika.
translation: The dreadful state of the road to the village keeps the buses from arriving on time in winter.

sentence: Ububi bokuxhatshazwa kwabantwana kufuneka buxelwe emapoliseni ngokukhawuleza.
translation: The evil of child abuse must be reported to the police without delay.

sentence: Umakhulu wayesithi ububi bomntu abukho ebusweni, bukwizenzo zakhe kuphela.
translation: Grandmother used to say a person's ugliness is not in the face, only in what they do.

sentence: Ekhaya sitya ndawo nye ngokuhlwa, akukho mntu otya egumbini lakhe.
translation: At home we all eat in one place in the evening; nobody eats in their own room.

sentence: Amagosa athi zonke izikolo zephondo mazibhale uviwo ngaxesha nye.
translation: The officials said every school in the province must sit the exam at one and the same time.

sentence: Abahlali baphendula ngazwi nye, besithi abayifuni indawo yokulahla inkunkuma elalini.
translation: The residents answered with one voice that they do not want a rubbish dump in the village.

sentence: Eli lifu limnyama liza nemvula, khawuleza usonge impahla eyomileyo.
translation: This black cloud is bringing rain — hurry up and fold in the dry washing.

sentence: Eli xesha lokuvuna umbona lifuna ukuba bonke abantwana bancedise emasimini.
translation: This maize harvest season needs every one of the children to help out in the fields.

sentence: Eli thuba lokufunda eyunivesithi ndalifumana kanye, andisayi kulilahla.
translation: This chance to study at university came to me just once, and I am not going to waste it.

sentence: Amaqanda lawo abolile, ndiza kuwalahla ngaphambi kokuba sipheke.
translation: Those eggs have gone off - I'll throw them out before we start cooking.

sentence: Amapolisa lawo asimisile endleleni, afuna ukubona ilayisensi katata.
translation: Those policemen have stopped us on the road; they want to see Dad's licence.

sentence: Amazwi lawo abuhlungu kakhulu, andisakwazi ukujonga umhlobo wam emehlweni.
translation: Those words hurt so much that I can no longer look my friend in the eye.

sentence: Intombi enkulu igcina abantwana xa umama esemsebenzini ebusuku.
translation: The eldest girl looks after the children when Mom is at work on night shift.

sentence: Intombi kaNomsa isebenza evenkileni ngeempelaveki ukuze ihlawule imali yesikolo.
translation: Nomsa's daughter works at the shop on weekends so that she can pay her school fees.

sentence: Intombi yam iphumelele ibanga leshumi, ndinebhongo kangangokuba ndiyalila.
translation: My daughter has passed matric - I'm so proud I'm in tears.

sentence: La manzi abanda kakhulu, abantwana bayakhala xa ndibahlamba.
translation: This water is far too cold; the children cry when I wash them.

sentence: La maxwebhu kufuneka asayinwe ngumphathi ngaphambi kokuba siwathumele.
translation: These documents have to be signed by the manager before we send them off.

sentence: La mabali kamakhulu ayasothusa, andifuni ukulala ndodwa namhlanje ebusuku.
translation: These stories of Grandma's give us a fright - I don't want to sleep alone tonight.

sentence: Umnyango wona uvaliwe, kodwa ifestile ndiyishiye ivuliwe ubusuku bonke.
translation: The door itself is locked, but I left the window standing open all night.

sentence: Umvuzo katata ufika ekupheleni kwenyanga, kodwa wona uphela ngeeveki ezimbini.
translation: Dad's wages do arrive at the end of the month, but they themselves are gone within two weeks.

sentence: Umculo kamama undithuthuzela; wona wodwa uyakwazi ukuthoba intliziyo yam.
translation: Mom's music comforts me; it alone can settle my heart.

sentence: Oku kutya kwasala izolo, kodwa kusamnandi xa sikufudumeza kancinci.
translation: This food was left over from yesterday, but it's still good if we warm it a little.

sentence: Oku kusebenza ebusuku kundidinisa, ndicinga ukucela ukuba ndisebenze emini.
translation: This working at night is wearing me out; I'm thinking of asking to work days instead.

sentence: Oku kuthetha kwakho phambi kwabantu kundihlazisa, ndicela uyeke.
translation: This way you talk in front of people embarrasses me - please stop.

sentence: Ndacela inceba kumakhulu emva kokwaphula isitya sakhe esitsha.
translation: I begged Grandma for mercy after breaking her new dish.

sentence: Ijaji yabonisa inceba kumfana, yamnika ithuba lokugqibezela isikolo.
translation: The judge showed the young man mercy and gave him a chance to finish school.

sentence: Inceba yakhe yandothusa kakhulu, ndandilindele umsindo nesohlwayo esikhulu.
translation: Her mercy took me completely by surprise; I had been expecting anger and a heavy punishment.

sentence: Umsebenzi wasefama uvuka ngentsimbi yesine ukuze asenge iinkomo.
translation: The farm worker gets up at four in the morning to milk the cows.

sentence: Umsebenzi wasekhitshini uphakele abantu abangamakhulu amabini kumtshato wezolo.
translation: The kitchen worker dished up for two hundred people at yesterday's wedding.

sentence: Umsebenzi omdala wakhala mhla wathatha umhlala-phantsi emva kweminyaka engamashumi amathathu.
translation: The old labourer wept the day he retired, after thirty years on the job.

sentence: Indlela eya ekhaya izele ludaka xa kunetha, iiteksi ziyeka ukungena.
translation: The road home fills up with mud when it rains, and the taxis stop coming in.

sentence: Umqhubi wethu wakhetha indlela endala yeenkomo, safika kade emsebenzini.
translation: Our driver took the old cattle track, and we got to work late.

sentence: Indlela yasezantsi indoyikisa ebusuku, ndikhetha ukujika ngasecaweni nangona inde.
translation: The lower road frightens me at night, so I go round past the church even though it's longer.

sentence: Ilifa likatatomkhulu lahlulwa ngokulinganayo phakathi kwabantwana bakhe abathandathu.
translation: Grandfather's inheritance was divided equally among his six children.

sentence: Igqwetha lisixelele ukuba ilifa alinakwabiwa ngaphambi kokufundwa komyolelo.
translation: The lawyer told us the inheritance cannot be shared out before the will is read.

sentence: Ilifa endilifunayo kubazali bam lulwazi, hayi umhlaba okanye imali.
translation: The inheritance I want from my parents is knowledge, not land or money.

sentence: Izandla zam zabanda emlanjeni, andikwazanga nokubamba isepha ndihlamba iimpahla.
translation: My hands went numb at the river; I couldn't even keep hold of the soap while washing the clothes.

sentence: Izandla zikatata zomile kukusebenza emgodini ubomi bakhe bonke.
translation: Dad's hands are rough and cracked from working in the mine his whole life.

sentence: Izandla zam bezingcangcazela xa ndinikwa isatifikethi phambi kwesikolo sonke.
translation: My hands were shaking as I was handed the certificate in front of the whole school.

sentence: Utatomkhulu wathengisa inkunzi emnyama ukuze umzukulwana wakhe aye eyunivesithi.
translation: Grandfather sold the black bull so that his grandson could go to university.

sentence: Umalusi wayibopha inkunzi emthini ngaphambi kokuba afike umthengi wenkomo.
translation: The herdboy tied the bull to the tree before the cattle buyer arrived.

sentence: Ndoyika inkunzi yommelwane kuba isoloko ihlasela nabani na odlula ecingweni.
translation: I'm afraid of the neighbour's bull, because it always charges anyone who walks past the fence.

sentence: Umama ubhaka isonka kusasa ngeCawa, kuba ibandla lisela iti ekhaya emva kwenkonzo.
translation: Mum bakes bread early on Sunday, because the congregation has tea at our house after the service.

sentence: Ibandla likhethe amagosa amatsha emva kwentlanganiso ende yangoMgqibelo.
translation: The congregation elected new stewards after a long Saturday meeting.

sentence: Ibandla landamkela ndingazi mntu, ngoko ndiziva ndisekhaya rhoqo ngeCawa.
translation: The congregation took me in when I knew no one, so I feel at home there every Sunday.

sentence: Beka eso sitya phezu kwefriji, abantwana bangasithathi bedlala ekhitshini.
translation: Put that dish up on the fridge, so the children don't grab it while they're playing in the kitchen.

sentence: Eso sicwangciso sikaMandla asisebenzi, kuba abasebenzi bagoduka ngentsimbi yesine.
translation: That plan of Mandla's doesn't work, because the workers go home at four o'clock.

sentence: Eso sipho sikamama sindikhumbuza ngaye ngalo lonke ixesha ndisibona.
translation: That gift from my mother reminds me of her every single time I see it.

sentence: Umama uphemba umlilo ngamaphepha amadala xa iinkuni zimanzi ebusika.
translation: Mum gets the fire going with old newspaper when the firewood is damp in winter.

sentence: Umlilo watshisa amatyotyombe amathathu eKhayelitsha phambi kokuba kufike uncedo.
translation: The fire burned down three shacks in Khayelitsha before help arrived.

sentence: Ndisakhumbula umlilo wasebusuku, apho utatomkhulu wayesibalisela amabali okudala.
translation: I still remember the night fire, where grandfather used to tell us the old stories.

sentence: Umhlaba wasegadini uqinile kakhulu, kufuneka siwunkcenkceshele phambi kokuba silime.
translation: The soil in the garden has gone hard; we have to water it before we can dig.

sentence: Umhlaba wookhokho bethu wathathwa ngexesha lengcinezelo, kwaye usapho lwafudukela edolophini.
translation: Our ancestors' land was taken during the years of oppression, and the family moved to town.

sentence: Xa ndime encotsheni yentaba, ndiva ngathi umhlaba wonke uphantsi kwam.
translation: When I stand on the mountain top, it feels as though the whole world lies beneath me.

sentence: Udade wam uthi ubulungisa abukho ekhaya, kuba nguye yedwa ohlamba izitya.
translation: My sister says there is no justice at home, because she is the only one who washes the dishes.

sentence: Usapho lulinde ubulungisa iminyaka emihlanu enkundleni, kodwa ityala alikagqitywa.
translation: The family has waited five years for justice in court, but the case still isn't finished.

sentence: Ndikholelwa ukuba ubulungisa buyafika, nokuba bufika emva kwexesha elide kakhulu.
translation: I believe that justice does come, even if it arrives after a very long time.

sentence: Ndabuza unyana wam inyaniso ngefestile eyaphukileyo, waza wavuma engekafiki utata.
translation: I asked my son for the truth about the broken window, and he owned up before his father got home.

sentence: Ijaji yalixelela ingqina ukuba lithethe inyaniso yonke phambi kwenkundla.
translation: The judge told the witness to speak the whole truth before the court.

sentence: Inyaniso ibuhlungu, kodwa ndikhetha ukuyiva kunokuqhubeka ndixokiselwa ngabahlobo.
translation: The truth hurts, but I would rather hear it than go on being lied to by friends.

sentence: Umakhulu usibalisela ukuba uhlanga lwethu lwafika kule ntlambo kudala kakhulu.
translation: Grandmother tells us that our people came to this valley a very long time ago.

sentence: Kwintlanganiso yeenkokeli, umbuzo wokuba uhlanga lusachaphazela imivuzo waphinda wavuka.
translation: At the leaders' meeting, the question of whether race still affects wages came up again.

sentence: Utata wayesithi uhlanga aluchazi mntu; izenzo zakhe kuphela ezimchazayo.
translation: Dad used to say that race defines nobody; only a person's deeds define them.

sentence: Umntwana wabetha intloko etafileni, ndaza ndambeka iqhwa kwindawo edumbileyo.
translation: The child banged his head on the table, and I put ice on the swollen spot.

sentence: Ugqirha wajonga intloko yomdlali emva kokuwa kwakhe kabuhlungu ebaleni lebhola.
translation: The doctor examined the player's head after he fell badly on the soccer field.

sentence: Umakhulu wandiphulula intloko wathi ndingakhathazeki, konke kuza kulunga.
translation: Grandmother stroked my head and told me not to worry, everything would come right.

sentence: Ilanga selitshonile, kodwa impahla isesemgceni; masiyithathe phambi kwemvula.
translation: The sun has already set and the washing is still on the line; let's bring it in before the rain.

sentence: Umalume uthengisa impahla esetyenzisiweyo kwimarike yaseBhayi rhoqo ngoMgqibelo.
translation: My uncle sells second-hand goods at the Gqeberha market every Saturday.

sentence: Ndakhupha yonke impahla katata ekhabhathini, kodwa andikwazanga ukuyilahla.
translation: I took all my father's clothes out of the wardrobe, but I couldn't bring myself to throw them away.

sentence: Umama umi emnyango, ebuza ukuba ndipheka ntoni ngokuhlwa.
translation: Mum is standing in the doorway, asking what I'm cooking tonight.

sentence: Kwintlanganiso yanamhlanje umphathi ubuzile ukuba senza ntoni ngezikhalazo zabathengi.
translation: In today's meeting the manager asked what we are doing about the customers' complaints.

sentence: Andiqondi ukuba ufuna ntoni kum emva kwayo yonke le minyaka.
translation: I don't understand what you want from me after all these years.

sentence: Umntwana wawa ebhayisekileni phambi kwendlu, igazi laphuma empumlweni yakhe.
translation: The child fell off his bicycle in front of the house, and blood ran from his nose.

sentence: Eklinikhi unesi wandixelela ukuba igazi lam linqabile, ngoko ndinikela rhoqo.
translation: At the clinic the nurse told me my blood type is rare, so I donate regularly.

sentence: Nangona singadibani kakhulu, igazi lethu linye, ngoko ndisoloko ndimxhasa.
translation: Even though we hardly ever see each other, we are of one blood, so I always stand by him.

sentence: Umfazi othengisa imifino ekoneni yesitalato uhlala endigcinela iimbotyi ezintsha.
translation: The woman who sells vegetables on the street corner always keeps fresh beans aside for me.

sentence: Umfazi wakwamelwane undicele ukuba ndimgcinele abantwana ngoLwesihlanu, esiya emngcwabeni.
translation: The woman next door asked me to mind her children on Friday while she goes to a funeral.

sentence: Umfazi wam undixelele ukuba ndiyeke ukusebenza ubusuku bonke, uxhalabile.
translation: My wife has told me to stop working all night; she is worried about me.

sentence: Hayi, andizukuyivula loo bhotile yewayini phambi kokuba abantwana balale.
translation: No, I'm not opening that bottle of wine before the children are asleep.

sentence: Hayi bhuti, le teksi ayiyi eMonti; kufuneka ulinde leyo ilandelayo.
translation: No, brother, this taxi doesn't go to East London; you'll have to wait for the next one.

sentence: Hayi bo, ndothukile kuba ulibele usuku lokuzalwa lukamama kwakhona.
translation: Oh no, I'm stunned that you've forgotten Mum's birthday again.

sentence: Utitshala usixelele ukuba ubukumkani bukaShaka babusaziwa kuwo wonke lo mmandla.
translation: The teacher told us that Shaka's kingdom was known throughout this whole region.

sentence: NgoDisemba ndatyelela eSwatini, ubukumkani obuncinci apho ndabukela umdaniso wesintu.
translation: In December I visited Eswatini, the small kingdom where I watched a traditional dance.

sentence: Umfundisi wathetha ngobukumkani bezulu ixesha elide, kwada kwatshona ilanga.
translation: The minister preached about the kingdom of heaven for so long that the sun went down.

sentence: Vala umlomo xa uhlafuna, mntwana; sitya nabantu abadala etafileni.
translation: Close your mouth while you chew, child; we are eating at the table with grown-ups.

sentence: Ugqirha wamazinyo wandicela ukuba ndivule umlomo, waza wafumana umngxuma.
translation: The dentist asked me to open my mouth, and then he found a cavity.

sentence: Umlomo wakhe awuthuli nakanye; uxelela wonke umntu iimfihlo zekhaya.
translation: His mouth never rests for a moment; he tells everyone the family's secrets.

sentence: Ngenxa yobushushu sitye isidlo sangokuhlwa ngaphandle phantsi komnquma.
translation: Because of the heat we ate supper outside under the olive tree.

sentence: Akukho mntu onokungena kule ofisi ngaphandle kwemvume yomphathi.
translation: Nobody may go into this office without the manager's permission.

sentence: Bonke abantwana bagoduke ngebhasi ngaphandle kukaThandi, olinde umama wakhe esangweni ekhathazekile.
translation: All the children have gone home on the bus except Thandi, who is waiting anxiously for her mother at the gate.

sentence: Vala iifestile ngaphambi kokuba silale, hleze imvula ingene endlwini.
translation: Close the windows before we go to bed, in case the rain gets into the house.

sentence: Ndiye ndakhawuleza ndayigqiba ingxelo, hleze umphathi acaphuke phambi kwabasebenzi.
translation: I hurried and finished the report, lest the manager lose his temper in front of the staff.

sentence: Umakhulu wandilumkisa ukuba ndingahambi ndodwa ebusuku, hleze ndihlangane nengxaki elokishini.
translation: Grandmother warned me not to walk alone at night, in case I run into trouble in the township.

sentence: Umama uthenge inyama yenkomo ukuze siyose ngoMgqibelo xa kufika iindwendwe.
translation: Mum has bought beef so that we can braai it on Saturday when the visitors arrive.

sentence: Erenkini abafazi bathengisa inyama eyosiweyo nesonka ngexesha lesidlo sasemini.
translation: At the taxi rank the women sell grilled meat and bread at lunchtime.

sentence: Kunyaka ophelileyo ndayeka inyama, kodwa ivumba lokosa kwabamelwane liyandihenda.
translation: Last year I gave up meat, but the smell of the neighbours' braai still tempts me.

sentence: Umsindo kaTata wancipha ngokukhawuleza emva kokuba umakhulu ethethile naye.
translation: Father's anger died down quickly after Grandmother had a word with him.

sentence: Emsebenzini umsindo womphathi wenza ukuba abasebenzi boyike ukubuza imibuzo.
translation: At work the manager's temper makes the staff afraid to ask any questions.

sentence: Umsindo wam wandenza ndathetha kakubi, ndisazisola nanamhla oku.
translation: My anger made me speak cruelly, and I regret it to this day.

sentence: Imini yonke ndisebenza egadini, ndiphumla kuphela xa ilanga litshona.
translation: I work in the garden the whole day and only rest when the sun goes down.

sentence: Imini yayishushu kakhulu, ngoko abasebenzi baphumla emthunzini womthi omkhulu.
translation: The day was so hot that the workers rested in the shade of the big tree.

sentence: Imini ibinzima kakhulu emsebenzini namhlanje, ndifuna nje ukulala.
translation: The day has been so hard at work today that I just want to sleep.

sentence: Umakhulu wam uthi nguThixo osinceda xa izinto zisiba nzima.
translation: My grandmother says it is God who helps us when things get hard.

sentence: Utata wathi nguThixo osinike lo msebenzi, ngoko masiwenze ngenyameko.
translation: Father said it is God who gave us this job, so we should do it carefully.

sentence: Andiqinisekanga ukuba nguThixo obangela iimbalela, kodwa ndisathandaza yonke imihla.
translation: I am not sure it is God who sends the droughts, but I still pray every day.

sentence: Unyana wam wenze ikrele ngeplanga, udlala imfazwe egadini imini yonke.
translation: My son has made a sword out of a plank and plays at war in the garden all day.

sentence: Umdlali ophethe ikrele weza esiteji, laza iholo lonke lathi cwaka.
translation: The actor carrying the sword stepped onto the stage, and the whole hall fell silent.

sentence: Xa ndibona ikrele likatatomkhulu endongeni, ndikhumbula amabali emfazwe awayewabalisa.
translation: When I see my grandfather's sword on the wall, I remember the war stories he used to tell.

sentence: Isithunywa sankqonkqoza emnyango ngokuhlwa, sifuna ukubona umninimzi ngokukhawuleza.
translation: The messenger knocked at the door after dark, wanting to see the head of the homestead at once.

sentence: Ikomkhulu lithumele isithunywa ukuze sazise abantu ngentlanganiso yangomso.
translation: The chief's great place has sent a messenger to tell people about tomorrow's meeting.

sentence: Ndalinda isithunywa imini yonke, kodwa asizange sifike, ndaphelelwa lithemba.
translation: I waited for the messenger the whole day, but it never came and I lost hope.

sentence: Emva kokugula, andisenawo amandla okunyuka izitepsi ndisiya kwigumbi lam.
translation: Since my illness I no longer have the strength to climb the stairs up to my room.

sentence: Abafana bahlanganisa amandla abo, bawususa umthi owawuwele endleleni.
translation: The young men put their strength together and shifted the tree that had fallen across the road.

sentence: Ingoma kamakhulu indinika amandla okuqhubeka nokufunda de kuse.
translation: Grandmother's song gives me the strength to keep studying until dawn.

sentence: Iqanda lona ndilibilisile kakade, kodwa inyama isafuna imizuzu elishumi.
translation: The egg I have already boiled, but the meat still needs ten minutes.

sentence: Igama lam lona balibiza ngendlela engeyiyo emsebenzini, kodwa andisabalungisi.
translation: My name, that one they pronounce wrongly at work, but I no longer correct them.

sentence: Ithemba lona alipheli, nokuba imisebenzi ingafumaneki kule dolophu.
translation: Hope itself does not run out, even when no work can be found in this town.

sentence: Ubawo uvuka ngentsimbi yesine, aze enze itiye phambi kokuba sivuke.
translation: My father gets up at four o'clock and makes tea before the rest of us wake.

sentence: Ubawo wayesebenza emigodini yaseGoli iminyaka elishumi, esiza ekhaya ngeKrisimesi.
translation: My father worked in the Johannesburg mines for ten years, coming home at Christmas.

sentence: Ndiyamkhumbula ubawo kakhulu, ingakumbi xa ndisiva iingoma awayezithanda.
translation: I miss my father badly, especially when I hear the songs he used to love.

sentence: Ndasika isonka ndaqaba ibhotolo, ndilungiselela abantwana isidlo sakusasa.
translation: I cut the bread and spread butter on it, making the children's breakfast.

sentence: Ngexesha lekhefu emsebenzini sitya isonka netiye, sincokola ngebhola.
translation: During the break at work we eat bread and drink tea while chatting about football.

sentence: Isonka esishushu sisandikhumbuza umakhulu owayesibhaka ngeziko yonke imihla.
translation: Warm bread still reminds me of my grandmother, who baked it in the hearth every day.

sentence: Ubhuti wam wajoyina umkhosi, kwaye usibhalela iileta qho ngenyanga.
translation: My brother joined the army, and he writes us letters every month.

sentence: Umkhosi umise iintente ngaphandle kwedolophu, amajoni elinde imiyalelo.
translation: The army has pitched its tents outside the town, the soldiers waiting for orders.

sentence: Ndicinga ukuba umkhosi ufanele ukunceda abantu ngexesha lezikhukula, kungekhona ukulwa kuphela.
translation: I think the army ought to help people during the floods, not only fight.

sentence: Ndihlamba iingubo kanye ngeveki, ngoMgqibelo xa ndingayi emsebenzini.
translation: I wash the clothes once a week, on Saturday when I do not go to work.

sentence: Intlanganiso yabazali ibanjwa kanye ngekota, ngoko sonke sizama ukuya.
translation: The parents' meeting is held once a term, so we all try to attend.

sentence: Ndaya elwandle kanye kuphela ebomini bam, kodwa andisoze ndiyilibale loo mini.
translation: I have been to the sea only once in my life, but I will never forget that day.

sentence: NgoMgqibelo kusasa abafazi bahlamba iimpahla emlanjeni, bencokola ngabantwana babo.
translation: On Saturday morning the women wash clothes down at the river, gossiping about their children.

sentence: Abafazi belali bahlanganise imali yokwakha ivenkile encinci ecaleni kwendlela.
translation: The women of the village pooled their money to build a small shop beside the road.

sentence: Utata uthi abafazi babesoloko bebamba ikhaya xa amadoda esemgodini.
translation: Father says it was always the women who held the home together while the men were away at the mine.

sentence: Ewe, ndiyibonile imali oyishiye etafileni, ndaza ndayibeka ebhokisini.
translation: Yes, I did see the money you left on the table, and I put it in the box.

sentence: Umphathi wabuza ukuba ndiyakwazi na ukuqhuba; ndathi ewe, ndaqala ngoMvulo.
translation: The manager asked whether I could drive; I said yes, and I started on Monday.

sentence: Ewe, kubuhlungu, kodwa kufuneka sivume ukuba salibala umhla wakhe wokuzalwa.
translation: Yes, it hurts, but we have to admit that we forgot her birthday.

sentence: Iimpahla zam zona sezomile, kodwa ezabantwana zisamanzi ngenxa yemvula.
translation: My own clothes are dry by now, but the children's are still wet because of the rain.

sentence: Iincwadi zesikolo zona sizithengile, kodwa iiyunifomu asikazifumani kule veki.
translation: The schoolbooks we have already bought, but the uniforms we still haven't got hold of this week.

sentence: Ezi ngoma zona zindikhumbuza umakhulu, ngoko andikwazi ukuzimamela ndingakhali.
translation: These songs in particular remind me of my grandmother, so I can't listen to them without crying.

sentence: Umakhulu wayesithi ukulahla ukutya sisono, ngoko sasitya yonke into esityeni.
translation: Grandmother used to say that throwing away food is a sin, so we ate everything on the plate.

sentence: Emva kwentshumayelo, indoda leyo yavuma isono sayo phambi kwebandla lonke.
translation: After the sermon, that man confessed his sin in front of the whole congregation.

sentence: Andiqondi ukuba kusisono ukuhleka xa umntu ewile, kodwa umama uyakhathazeka.
translation: I don't think it's a sin to laugh when somebody falls over, but it upsets my mother.

sentence: Izulu lisibekele ukusukela kusasa, ngoko sishiye iimpahla ngaphakathi endlwini.
translation: The sky has been overcast since this morning, so we left the washing indoors.

sentence: Abalimi bakhangela izulu yonke intsasa, belindele imvula engekafiki nangoku.
translation: The farmers scan the sky every morning, waiting for rain that still hasn't come.

sentence: Ngokuhlwa sasilala phandle sibukele izulu ligcwele iinkwenkwezi, singathethi nto.
translation: In the evenings we would lie outside watching the sky fill with stars, saying nothing at all.

sentence: Ixesha lokutya lifika ngentsimbi yesithandathu, ngoko umama uqala ukupheka ngoku.
translation: Mealtime comes at six o'clock, so Mum is starting to cook right now.

sentence: Umphathi wathi ixesha lethu liphelile, kufuneka siwugqibe umsebenzi ngoLwesihlanu.
translation: The manager said our time is up and we have to finish the job by Friday.

sentence: Ixesha lihamba ngokukhawuleza xa uhleli nabahlobo bakho, kodwa licotha xa ulindile.
translation: Time runs fast when you're sitting with your friends, but it crawls when you're waiting.

sentence: Abantwana badlala ebaleni de kwahlwa, bengevi xa ndibabiza.
translation: The children played out in the yard until dark, not hearing me when I called them.

sentence: Abantwana besikolo balinde iteksi ecaleni kwendlela, izikhwama zabo zisemhlabeni.
translation: The schoolchildren are waiting for the taxi at the roadside, their bags down on the ground.

sentence: Xa abantwana bemka baye edolophini, indlu ishiyeka ithe cwaka kakhulu.
translation: When the children leave for the city, the house is left terribly quiet.

sentence: Ekhaya kwenziwa idini lokubulela izinyanya ngokusinda kukatatomkhulu esibhedlele.
translation: At home a sacrifice was made to thank the ancestors for grandfather pulling through at the hospital.

sentence: Ilali yonke iza kuhlanganisa imali, kuba idini lifuna inkomo enkulu.
translation: The whole village is going to pool money, because the sacrifice calls for a big ox.

sentence: Umama ukholelwa ukuba idini linika usapho uxolo, nangona utata engavumi.
translation: Mum believes that the sacrifice brings the family peace, even though Dad doesn't agree.

sentence: Thetha ngokucothayo, umakhulu akasakuva kakuhle emva kwalo mkhuhlane.
translation: Speak slowly; grandmother doesn't hear well any more after that illness.

sentence: Andikwazi ukuthetha isiBhulu, ngoko umlingane wam undincedisa kwiintlanganiso zabathengi.
translation: I can't speak Afrikaans, so my colleague helps me out in the meetings with customers.

sentence: Ndiyoyika ukuthetha phambi kwesihlwele; izandla zam ziyangcangcazela ndide ndilibale amagama.
translation: I'm frightened of speaking in front of a crowd; my hands shake until I forget my words.

sentence: Umama ushiye umyalelo etafileni wokuba sipheke irayisi silinde ukufika kwakhe.
translation: Mum left an instruction on the table that we should cook the rice and wait for her to get home.

sentence: Umyalelo womphathi uthi akukho mntu ushiya isakhiwo ngaphambi kwentsimbi yesihlanu.
translation: The manager's instruction is that nobody leaves the building before five o'clock.

sentence: Umyalelo wakhe wawungacacanga, ngoko sonke sagqiba umsebenzi ngendlela eyahlukileyo.
translation: His instruction wasn't clear, so each of us finished the work a different way.

sentence: Uyihlo uhlala esitulweni sakhe phandle, ephunga iti yasekuseni.
translation: Your father sits outside in his own chair, sipping his morning tea.

sentence: Ndidibene noyihlo evenkileni izolo, undibuze ngezifundo zam zaseyunivesithi.
translation: I ran into your father at the shop yesterday and he asked about my university studies.

sentence: Ndiyamhlonipha uyihlo kuba wasebenza kanzima ukuze ufunde eyunivesithi.
translation: I respect your father, because he worked himself hard so that you could study at university.

sentence: Ndisahlawula ityala lemoto yam, ngoko andinakuya eKapa ngeeholide.
translation: I'm still paying off my car loan, so I can't go down to Cape Town for the holidays.

sentence: Umninivenkile wandixolela ityala lam emva kokuba ndilahlekelwe ngumsebenzi.
translation: The shopkeeper wrote off my debt after I lost my job.

sentence: Andithandi ukuboleka imali kubahlobo, kuba ityala litshabalalisa ubuhlobo.
translation: I don't like borrowing money from friends, because debt destroys a friendship.

sentence: Xa kubanda ebusuku, ndongeza ingubo yoboya phezu kwabantwana.
translation: When it turns cold at night, I lay an extra wool blanket over the children.

sentence: Sithenge ingubo entsha emarikeni, kodwa ayilingani nebhedi yethu enkulu.
translation: We bought a new blanket at the market, but it doesn't fit our big bed.

sentence: Ndisathanda ingubo endala kamakhulu, ivumba layo lindikhumbuza ubuntwana bam.
translation: I still love grandmother's old blanket; its smell takes me back to my childhood.

sentence: Utata wabiya umda wesibaya ngamaplanga, kuba iinkomo zaziphuma ebusuku.
translation: Dad fenced the boundary of the kraal with planks, because the cattle kept getting out at night.

sentence: Umda phakathi kweMzantsi Afrika neLesotho uvaliwe ebusuku ngenxa yekhephu.
translation: The border between South Africa and Lesotho is closed at night because of the snow.

sentence: Ngoku udlule umda, akufanelekanga ukuba uthethe ngolo hlobo kubazali bakho.
translation: Now you have crossed the line; you have no business speaking to your parents that way.

sentence: Ndifundela abantwana incwadi yamabali rhoqo ngaphambi kokuba balale.
translation: I read the children a storybook every night before they go to sleep.

sentence: Ndiboleke incwadi yembali kwithala leencwadi, kufuneka ndiyibuyise ngoLwesihlanu.
translation: I borrowed a history book from the library, and I have to return it on Friday.

sentence: Ndiyithanda kakhulu incwadi kaMqhayi, ndiyifunde izihlandlo ezithathu ngonyaka ophelileyo.
translation: I love Mqhayi's book so much that I read it three times last year.

sentence: Ukufa kukatatomkhulu kwasishiya sonke sisentlungwini, kodwa intsapho yamanyana.
translation: Grandfather's death left every one of us grieving, but it drew the family together.

sentence: Ukufa kwabantwana ngenxa yesifo sohudo kunciphile emva kokufika kwamanzi acocekileyo.
translation: Deaths of children from diarrhoeal disease have dropped since clean water arrived.

sentence: Abazali bam bathi ukufa yinxalenye yobomi, asifanele ukukubalekela.
translation: My parents say death is part of life and that we shouldn't run away from it.

sentence: Ndicela uxolo kummelwane wam, izinja zam zikhale ubusuku bonke.
translation: I owe my neighbour an apology — my dogs barked the whole night through.

sentence: Iinkokeli zelali zadibana ukuze kubuye uxolo phakathi kweentsapho ezimbini.
translation: The village leaders sat down together so that peace could return between the two families.

sentence: Uxolo lwentliziyo lubuyile kum emva kokuba ndithethe notata wam.
translation: Peace came back into my heart once I had finally spoken to my father.

sentence: Ilanga litshisa kakhulu emini, ndixhoma impahla ngaphandle ukuze yome msinya.
translation: The sun is fierce at midday, so I hang the washing outside to dry it quickly.

sentence: Ebusika sivuka ilanga lingekaphumi, ukuze siyokutheza iinkuni entabeni.
translation: In winter we get up before the sun is out, so we can fetch firewood from the mountain.

sentence: Xa ilanga litshona ngasemlanjeni, iintaka ziyathula, umoya wam uphola.
translation: When the sun goes down by the river, the birds fall quiet and my spirit settles.

sentence: Umphathi wevenkile wandibuyisela imali emva kokuba isonka sibolile.
translation: The shop manager refunded my money after the bread turned out to be mouldy.

sentence: Umphathi omtsha ubize intlanganiso ngoMvulo kusasa, kufuneka sifike ngexesha.
translation: The new manager has called a meeting for Monday morning, and we have to be there on time.

sentence: Abasebenzi bayamthanda umphathi wabo, kuba ubaphulaphula xa benengxaki.
translation: The workers are fond of their manager, because he hears them out whenever they have a problem.

sentence: Ndifake amaqanda amane epanini, kuba abantwana bafuna isidlo sakusasa.
translation: I've put four eggs in the pan, because the children want their breakfast.

sentence: Kwintlanganiso yanamhlanje bekukho abasebenzi abane kuphela, abanye banefluwenza.
translation: Only four workers turned up at today's meeting; the rest are down with flu.

sentence: Ndichithe iiyure ezine ndilinde ugqirha, ndade ndamka ndinomsindo.
translation: I spent four hours waiting for the doctor and in the end walked out furious.

sentence: Ndifuna indawo ethuleyo yokufunda, kuba ekhaya kungxola kakhulu.
translation: I need a quiet place to study, because it's far too noisy at home.

sentence: Sifike kwangethuba erenkini ukuze sifumane indawo yokuhlala eteksini.
translation: We got to the taxi rank early so we'd get a seat in the taxi.

sentence: Ndikhumbula indawo esasidlala kuyo, ngoku kwakhiwe izindlu apho.
translation: I remember the spot where we used to play; houses have been built there now.

sentence: Utata uvala umculo xa iindaba ziqala kumabonwakude ngentsimbi yesixhenxe.
translation: Dad turns the music off when the news starts on TV at seven.

sentence: Umhlobo wam undixelele iindaba ezimnandi, ufumene umsebenzi eKapa.
translation: My friend gave me good news: she's got a job in Cape Town.

sentence: Iindaba zemfazwe zenza umakhulu angalali, uhlala ephethe unomathotholo.
translation: The war news keeps Grandma awake; she never puts the radio down.

sentence: Emva kwemvula, umakhulu ugrumba umhlaba aze afake imbewu yamathanga.
translation: After the rain, Grandma turns the soil over and puts in the pumpkin seed.

sentence: Abalimi bathenga imbewu yombona ngoAgasti, ukuze balime imvula ingekafiki.
translation: Farmers buy maize seed back in August so they can plough before the rains come.

sentence: Ndiyayikhathalela imbewu endayifumana kumakhulu, ndiyityale kwisitya esincinci efestileni.
translation: I treasure the seed Grandma gave me; I've planted it in a small dish on the windowsill.

sentence: Ndihamba ngeenyawo ukuya esikolweni kuba iteksi ibiza kakhulu.
translation: I walk to school because the taxi costs too much.

sentence: Hamba ngoku, mntanam, ukuze ubambe ibhasi yentsimbi yesithandathu.
translation: Go now, my child, so you catch the six o'clock bus.

sentence: Ikhaya lithi cwaka xa abantwana behamba, kodwa umsebenzi usedolophini.
translation: The house falls silent when the children leave, but the work is in the city.

sentence: Umama wabeka indlebe emnyango, efuna ukuva ukuba abantwana balele na.
translation: Mum put her ear to the door, wanting to hear whether the children were asleep.

sentence: Emva kweminyaka elishumi emgodini, indlebe yam yasekunene ayisevi kakuhle.
translation: After ten years down the mine, my right ear doesn't hear well any more.

sentence: Ndifunde ukuba indlebe ephulaphulayo inceda umhlobo ngaphezu kwamacebo amaninzi.
translation: I've learnt that a listening ear helps a friend more than a pile of advice.

sentence: Umntwana wethu waqala ukuthetha eneenyanga ezilishumi elinanye, sonke savuya.
translation: Our child started speaking at eleven months, and we were all delighted.

sentence: Ukuthetha phambi kwabantu abaninzi kundenza ndibe nexhala, kodwa ndiyazama.
translation: Speaking in front of a crowd makes me anxious, but I keep trying.

sentence: Ukuthetha kukamakhulu kuzolile, kodwa amazwi akhe ashiya umkhondo entliziyweni.
translation: Grandma's speech is calm, yet her words leave a mark on the heart.

sentence: Ukuba wenza njalo yonke imihla, imoto yakho iza kwonakala kwakamsinya.
translation: If you keep doing it that way every day, your car will pack up before long.

sentence: Utitshala wandibonisa indlela, wathi mandenze njalo kwimibuzo eseleyo.
translation: The teacher showed me the method and told me to do the same with the remaining questions.

sentence: Bendicinga ukuba uya kundinceda, kodwa akazange enze njalo.
translation: I thought he was going to help me, but he never did.

sentence: Ndiphuma ekhaya ngentsimbi yesithandathu ukuze ndifike emsebenzini ngexesha.
translation: I leave home at six so that I get to work on time.

sentence: Iteksi yasilibazisa endleleni, kodwa sifike ngexesha umtshato ungekaqali.
translation: The taxi held us up on the way, but we arrived in time, before the wedding started.

sentence: Ndiyacaphuka xa umntu engafiki ngexesha, kuba nam bendilinde ixesha elide.
translation: It irritates me when someone doesn't turn up on time, since I've been waiting a long while myself.

sentence: Ubulumko bukamakhulu busisindisile ngemini eyatsha ngayo indlu yommelwane.
translation: Grandma's good sense saved us the day the neighbour's house burned down.

sentence: Abadala belali basebenzisa ubulumko xa kukho ingxabano ngomhlaba.
translation: The village elders draw on their wisdom whenever there's a dispute over land.

sentence: Ndiyafunda ukuba ubulumko abufiki ngeminyaka kuphela, bufika nangeempazamo esizenzayo.
translation: I'm learning that wisdom doesn't arrive with age alone; it comes with the mistakes we make.

sentence: Umama ubeka iswekile phezulu ekhabhathini ukuze abantwana bangayifumani.
translation: Mum keeps the sugar high up in the cupboard so the children can't get at it.

sentence: Abasebenzi babeka uphawu phezulu kwesango, ukuze abantu balubone besekude.
translation: The workers mounted the sign high above the gate so people could see it from far off.

sentence: Intliziyo yam yatsiba phezulu xa ndabona igama lam kuluhlu lwabaphumeleleyo.
translation: My heart leapt when I saw my name on the list of those who had passed.

sentence: Umama wabhaka izonka ezithandathu ngoMgqibelo, saza sazithengisa kubamelwane bethu.
translation: Mum baked six loaves on Saturday, and we sold them to our neighbours.

sentence: Ivenkile yasekhoneni ithengisa izonka ezishushu ngeentsasa zeCawa, kodwa ziphela phambi kwentsimbi yesibhozo.
translation: The corner shop sells hot loaves on Sunday mornings, but they are gone before eight o'clock.

sentence: Andithandi ukutya izonka ezindala; ndikhetha ukubhaka ezam ekhaya kusasa.
translation: I don't like eating stale bread; I would rather bake my own at home in the morning.

sentence: Abafundi bema bathi cwaka, bacula umhobe wesizwe phambi kokungena eklasini.
translation: The pupils stood in complete silence, singing the national anthem before going into class.

sentence: Kwibala lemidlalo, isihlwele sonke sasukuma xa umhobe wesizwe uqala.
translation: At the stadium, the whole crowd rose to its feet when the national anthem began.

sentence: Umhobe wesizwe undenza ndikhale, ngakumbi xa uculwa ngabantwana besikolo.
translation: The national anthem makes me cry, especially when it is schoolchildren who are singing it.

sentence: Imfazwe yatshabalalisa ilali kamalume, waza wabalekela eMonti nosapho lwakhe.
translation: The war destroyed my uncle's village, and he fled to East London with his family.

sentence: Utitshala wachaza indlela imfazwe eyatshintsha ngayo imida yeli lizwe.
translation: The teacher explained the way the war changed the borders of this country.

sentence: Ndiyayithiya imfazwe kuba utata wabuya kuyo engasakwazi ukuhamba.
translation: I hate war, because my father came back from it unable to walk.

sentence: Ndabeka itafile ngakwelinye icala legumbi ukuze kubekho indawo yokudlala.
translation: I moved the table to the other side of the room so there would be space to play.

sentence: Umakhi undixelele ukuba icala lasemva lendlu lifuna udonga olutsha.
translation: The builder told me that the back side of the house needs a new wall.

sentence: Kule ngxabano, ndithatha icala likamama kuba ebenyanisile kwasekuqaleni.
translation: In this quarrel I am taking my mother's side, because she was right from the start.

sentence: Ndanika inja amathambo enkuku, yaza yawahlafuna phantsi kwetafile ubusuku bonke.
translation: I gave the dog the chicken bones, and it chewed them under the table all night.

sentence: Ugqirha uthe amathambo am abuthathaka, ngoko kufuneka ndiyeke ukuthwala imithwalo enzima.
translation: The doctor said my bones are weak, so I have to stop carrying heavy loads.

sentence: Emva kokusebenza emasimini imini yonke, amathambo am ayaqaqamba ebusuku.
translation: After working in the fields all day, my bones ache at night.

sentence: Umakhulu wandinika icebo elihle malunga nendlela yokupheka umngqusho ngaphandle kwenyama.
translation: Grandmother gave me good advice about how to cook samp without any meat.

sentence: Kwintlanganiso yabasebenzi, sacela icebo kumphathi wethu malunga nokunciphisa iiyure zomsebenzi.
translation: At the staff meeting we asked our manager for advice about cutting back our working hours.

sentence: Ndalilandela icebo lakho lokuthetha notata ngokuzolileyo, ngoku uyandimamela.
translation: I followed your advice about speaking to my father calmly, and now he listens to me.

sentence: Ngomso umakhulu ufika ngebhasi yaseGqeberha, ngoko kufuneka sicoce indlu namhlanje.
translation: Grandmother arrives tomorrow on the bus from Gqeberha, so we have to clean the house today.

sentence: Ngomso ndiya edolophini ukuya kufaka isicelo somsebenzi kwivenkile entsha.
translation: Tomorrow I am going into town to hand in a job application at the new shop.

sentence: Ndinexhala kuba ngomso ndibhala uviwo lwezibalo endingalulungiselelanga kakuhle.
translation: I am anxious, because tomorrow I write the maths exam that I have not prepared for properly.

sentence: Usodolophu wenza intetho ende embhiyozweni, kwaza kwana imvula phakathi kwayo.
translation: The mayor made a long speech at the celebration, and then it started raining halfway through it.

sentence: Ndayilibala intetho endandiyilungiselele emtshatweni kadade wethu, ndaza ndakhala.
translation: I forgot the speech I had prepared for my sister's wedding, and ended up in tears.

sentence: Intetho yale nkokeli yandivuselela ithemba, nangona ndandingamthembi ngaphambili.
translation: This leader's speech rekindled my hope, even though I had not trusted him before.

sentence: Esiya situlo sasekhitshini sophukile, ngoko utata uza kusilungisa ngempelaveki.
translation: That chair over there in the kitchen is broken, so Dad is going to fix it at the weekend.

sentence: Esiya sibhedlele savalwa ngonyaka ophelileyo, ngoko abantu bahamba imigama emide.
translation: That hospital over there closed last year, so people now travel long distances.

sentence: Andisithandi esiya sitya esikhulu; ndikhetha esi sincinci sikamakhulu.
translation: I don't like that big bowl over there; I prefer this small one of grandmother's.

sentence: Ithole lazalwa ebusuku ebuhlanti, laza lamunya ubisi lukanina ekuseni.
translation: The calf was born during the night in the kraal, and by morning it was suckling its mother's milk.

sentence: Utatomkhulu wathengisa ithole emakethe yaseCofimvaba ukuze ahlawule imali yesikolo.
translation: Grandfather sold a calf at the Cofimvaba market so that he could pay the school fees.

sentence: Ithole elincinci landilandela endleleni yonke, ndaza ndaqonda ukuba lilambile.
translation: The little calf followed me the whole way, and then I realised that it was hungry.

sentence: Umntwana uphuma ebhafini abaleke ze endlwini yonke, umama emsukela ngetawuli.
translation: The child gets out of the bath and runs naked through the whole house, with his mother chasing him with a towel.

sentence: Amakhwenkwe ayequbha ze emlanjeni de abone utitshala esiza.
translation: The boys were swimming naked in the river until they saw the teacher coming.

sentence: Ndaphupha ndihamba ze esitalatweni esixakekileyo, ndavuka ndibila ngamanzi.
translation: I dreamt I was walking naked down a busy street, and woke up drenched in sweat.

sentence: Isilivere sikamakhulu sihleli ekhabhathini unyaka wonke, sikhutshwa kuphela ngeKrisimesi.
translation: Grandmother's silver sits in the cupboard all year and only comes out at Christmas.

sentence: Umsebenzi wakhe kukucoca isilivere sasehotele rhoqo kusasa phambi kwesidlo.
translation: His job is polishing the hotel's silver every morning before breakfast.

sentence: Ndikhetha isilivere kunegolide, kuba sihamba nayo yonke into endiyinxibayo.
translation: I prefer silver to gold, because it goes with everything I wear.

sentence: Ehlotyeni sitya isidlo sangokuhlwa phandle phantsi komthi, kushushu endlwini.
translation: In summer we eat supper outside under the tree, because it is hot indoors.

sentence: Igumbi lokufundela lishushu kakhulu, ngoko utitshala uqhuba iklasi phandle.
translation: The classroom is far too hot, so the teacher is holding the lesson outside.

sentence: Xa ndikhathazwa ziingcinga, ndiphuma ndihambe phandle de ndizole.
translation: When my thoughts are troubling me, I go out and walk around outside until I settle.

sentence: Iliso lam ladumba emva kokulunywa yinyosi egadini kamakhulu.
translation: My eye swelled up after a bee stung me in grandmother's garden.

sentence: Umphathi ubeka iliso kubasebenzi abatsha kwiiveki zabo zokuqala.
translation: The manager keeps an eye on the new workers during their first few weeks.

sentence: Ndabona iliso likatata ligcwala iinyembezi xa sithetha ngomakhulu.
translation: I saw my father's eye fill with tears when we talked about grandmother.

sentence: Inkulu yasekhaya kufuneka ijonge abantwana abancinane xa abazali bengekho.
translation: The first-born of the household has to watch the little ones when the parents are away.

sentence: Emngcwabeni katata, kwafuneka inkulu ithethe egameni losapho lonke.
translation: At my father's funeral, the first-born had to speak on behalf of the whole family.

sentence: Inkulu ithwala uxanduva lwekhaya lonke, kodwa akukho mntu ubulelayo.
translation: The eldest son carries the responsibility for the entire household, yet nobody ever says thank you.

sentence: Ubunzima bale ngxowa yempuphu bundenza ndime kathathu endleleni eya ekhaya.
translation: The weight of this sack of flour makes me stop three times on the way home.

sentence: Umqhubi uthe ubunzima belori bugqithile kumlinganiselo ovunyelweyo, kufuneka sikhuphe iingxowa.
translation: The driver says the truck's weight is over the permitted limit, so we have to take some sacks off.

sentence: Ekliniki bathe ubunzima bomntwana wam bunyuka kakuhle, ndaphefumla ngoxolo.
translation: At the clinic they said my child's weight is rising nicely, and I breathed a sigh of relief.

sentence: Ummelwane wethu usinika amaqanda qho ngeveki, thina simnika imifuno yasegadini.
translation: Our neighbour gives us eggs every week, and we give her vegetables from the garden.

sentence: Xa sisiya emsebenzini, ummelwane uhlala nabantwana bethu de sibuye.
translation: When we go off to work, the neighbour stays with our children until we get back.

sentence: Ummelwane wam uvula umculo ngokuvakalayo ebusuku, ndide ndingalali.
translation: My neighbour turns the music up loud at night, to the point where I get no sleep.

sentence: Ixabiso lesonka lishumi leerandi ngoku, ngoko sithenga esinye kuphela ngosuku.
translation: The price of bread is ten rands now, so we buy only one loaf a day.

sentence: Inani labafundi abafikileyo namhlanje lishumi, abanye bathintelwe yimvula.
translation: The number of pupils who turned up today is ten; the rest were kept away by the rain.

sentence: Ixesha lokulinda ibhasi lishumi lemizuzu, kodwa kubanda ngathi ziiyure.
translation: The wait for the bus is ten minutes, but in the cold it feels like hours.

sentence: Imithi endayityalayo egadini ikhulile, ngoku sihlala emthunzini wayo ehlotyeni.
translation: The trees I planted in the garden have grown, and now we sit in their shade in summer.

sentence: Umasipala ugawula imithi emidala esitalatweni kuba iwisa amasebe ezindlwini.
translation: The municipality is cutting down the old trees on the street because they drop branches onto the houses.

sentence: Ndikhathazekile kuba imithi yakwaMakhulu yomile emva kwembalela ende.
translation: I am heartsore because the trees at my grandmother's place died after the long drought.

sentence: Emva kokuba abantwana belele, kuthi cwaka endlwini ndikwazi ukufunda incwadi yam.
translation: Once the children are asleep the house goes completely quiet and I can finally read my book.

sentence: Kwathi cwaka eholweni xa intombazana encinci iqala ukucula.
translation: The hall fell dead silent when the little girl started to sing.

sentence: Xa ndibuza ngotata wam, kuthi cwaka etafileni, akukho mntu ondijongayo.
translation: When I ask about my father, silence falls over the table and nobody will look at me.

sentence: Obo busuku bemvula asilalanga, silinde utata owayengekafiki ekhaya.
translation: That rainy night none of us slept, waiting for Dad, who still hadn't come home.

sentence: Obo buchule bokuluka bufundiswa ngoomakhulu kuphela, hayi ezikolweni.
translation: That weaving skill is passed on only by the grandmothers, not in schools.

sentence: Obo bomi basedolophini bundidinisa kakhulu, ndifuna ukubuyela emaXhoseni.
translation: That city life wears me right out; I want to go back to the Xhosa countryside.

sentence: Ulwimi lwam lwatsha xa ndandisitya isidudu esishushu kakhulu kusasa.
translation: I burnt my tongue this morning eating porridge that was far too hot.

sentence: Emsebenzini kufuneka usebenzise ulwimi lwesiXhosa xa uthetha nabathengi bethu.
translation: At work you have to use isiXhosa when you're dealing with our customers.

sentence: Ulwimi lwenkobe lufa kancinci xa abantwana bengasaluthethi ekhaya nasezitratweni.
translation: A mother tongue dies slowly when children stop speaking it at home and in the streets.

sentence: Izenzo zabantwana bam ekhaya zibonisa kakuhle into esibafundise yona.
translation: What my children do at home shows clearly what we have taught them.

sentence: Inkokeli yethu ithembisa kakhulu, kodwa izenzo zayo azihambelani namazwi ayo.
translation: Our leader promises a great deal, but her actions don't match her words.

sentence: Izenzo zobubele zikamakhulu zandifundisa ukuba ubuntu abuthengwa ngamali.
translation: My grandmother's acts of kindness taught me that decency cannot be bought with money.

sentence: Umntwana wam uzoba iinkomo zikatatomkhulu kuzo zonke iincwadi zesikolo.
translation: My child draws his grandfather's cattle on every page of his school books.

sentence: Kwiklasi yobugcisa, sizoba imephu yelali yethu ebonisa iindlela nomlambo.
translation: In the art class we are drawing a map of our village showing the roads and the river.

sentence: Xa ndikhathazekile ndizoba ubuso bukamakhulu, kuba oko kuzolisa intliziyo yam.
translation: When I'm troubled I draw my grandmother's face, because it settles my heart.

sentence: Udonga lwegumbi lam luvuza amanzi emva kwemvula enkulu yayizolo.
translation: The wall of my room is seeping water after yesterday's heavy rain.

sentence: Abafundi bebanga lesibhozo balupeyinte udonga lwesikolo ngamabala akhanyayo.
translation: The grade-eight learners have painted the school wall in bright colours.

sentence: Udonga olutsha lwabamelwane lusivalele ilanga, ngoku igadi yethu ayikhuli.
translation: The neighbours' new wall blocks our sunlight, and now nothing in our garden grows.

sentence: Umama ubhala amagama ethu onke ezimpahleni zesikolo ngaphambi kokuqala konyaka.
translation: Mum writes all our names into our school clothes before the year starts.

sentence: Kwintlanganiso yelali unobhala wafunda amagama abantu abafumene izindlu ezintsha.
translation: At the village meeting the secretary read out the names of the people who received new houses.

sentence: Amagama omthandazo kamakhulu asenkumbulweni yam nangoku, nangona wandishiya kudala.
translation: The words of my grandmother's prayer are still in my memory, though she left me long ago.

sentence: Utata wafaka umqondiso wesilumkiso esangweni lethu, kuba inja yethu iyaluma.
translation: Dad put a warning sign up on our gate, because our dog really does bite.

sentence: Emsebenzini umqondiso obomvu uthetha ukuba akukho mntu ufanele angene kwelo gumbi.
translation: At work the red sign means that nobody is allowed into that room.

sentence: Kutata, umqondiso wothando awukho kumazwi, ukwimisebenzi yakhe yemihla ngemihla.
translation: With my father, the sign of love isn't in words; it's in the things he does every day.

sentence: Intaba engasemva kwendlu yethu inekhephu phezulu ngasekupheleni kukaJulayi.
translation: The mountain behind our house has snow on its top by the end of July.

sentence: Abelusi banyuka intaba kusasa kakhulu, belandela iigusha ezilahlekileyo.
translation: The herd boys climb the mountain at first light, tracking the sheep that have strayed.

sentence: Intaba leyo ibaluleke kakhulu kuthi, kuba amakhwenkwe ethu enziwa amadoda phaya.
translation: That mountain matters a great deal to us, because it is where our boys are made men.

sentence: Ingqolowa siyigaya ngokwethu ekhaya, ukuze umgubo ube mtsha xa sibhaka.
translation: We grind the wheat ourselves at home, so the flour is fresh when we bake.

sentence: Ingqolowa yalo nyaka ayivunwanga kakuhle, kuba imvula ayizanga ngexesha.
translation: This year's wheat came in badly, because the rains never arrived on time.

sentence: Ndiyakholelwa ukuba ingqolowa yalapha ingcono kunaleyo ithengiswa ezivenkileni ezinkulu.
translation: I'm convinced the wheat grown here is better than what the big shops sell.

sentence: Umakhulu usixelela ngobusuku impi eyafika ngabo elalini, kwabaleka wonke umntu.
translation: Grandmother tells us about the night the army arrived in the village and everyone ran.

sentence: Impi kaHintsa yalwa namajoni aseBhritane kwiintaba zaseNciba, kwaphalala igazi.
translation: Hintsa's regiment fought the British soldiers in the hills along the Kei, and blood was spilt.

sentence: Andikholelwa ukuba impi ingasombulula ingxaki phakathi kwabantu abalambileyo.
translation: I don't believe an army can solve anything among people who are going hungry.

sentence: Utata wakhe wakha izindlu ezintathu elalini ngaphambi kokuba agule.
translation: His father built three houses in the village before he fell ill.

sentence: Kule lokishi izindlu zininzi kakhulu, kodwa amanzi afika kanye ngeveki.
translation: There are far too many houses in this township, but the water only comes once a week.

sentence: Ndiyazikhumbula izindlu zakudala esasidlala kuzo, ngoku kukho iivenkile kuloo ndawo.
translation: I still remember the old houses we used to play in; now there are shops on that spot.

sentence: Ubani ohambe nezitshixo zam, ndime elangeni ngaphandle kwendlu?
translation: Who walked off with my keys? I'm standing out in the sun, locked out of the house.

sentence: Ubani ophethe amaxwebhu, kuba umphathi ufuna ukuwaxoxa ngentsimbi yesithathu?
translation: Who has the documents? The manager wants to go through them at three o'clock.

sentence: Emva komngcwabo sasibuzana ukuba ubani oza kukhathalela abantwana ngoku.
translation: After the funeral we kept asking one another who was going to look after the children now.

sentence: Abaya bantu bemi esitophini sebhasi sele belinde iiyure ezimbini.
translation: Those people standing at the bus stop over there have already been waiting two hours.

sentence: Abaya bathengisi abangaphesheya kwendlela bathengisa amaqanda ngexabiso eliphantsi kunelethu.
translation: Those traders across the road sell eggs at a lower price than ours.

sentence: Andibathembi abaya bantu abahleli emotweni emnyama kufuphi nesango lethu.
translation: I don't trust those people sitting in the black car near our gate.

sentence: Emva kweentsuku ezintathu elwandle, usindiso lwabo lwafika ngesikhephe sabalobi.
translation: After three days at sea, their rescue arrived in a fishermen's boat.

sentence: Umfundisi wathi usindiso alunakuthengwa ngemali, lufumaneka ngobabalo kuphela.
translation: The minister said salvation cannot be bought with money; it comes by grace alone.

sentence: Kuye, usindiso lwafika ngohlobo lwencwadi eyayibhalwe ngumhlobo wakhe wakudala.
translation: For him, salvation came in the form of a letter written by an old friend.

sentence: Ukholo lukamakhulu lwalusenza sithandaze phambi kwesidlo sangokuhlwa yonke imihla.
translation: Grandmother's faith had us praying before supper every single day.

sentence: Ukholo lwakhe alumvumeli ukuba asebenze ngeCawa, ngoko utshintshiselana amaxesha neqabane lakhe.
translation: His faith won't let him work on a Sunday, so he swaps shifts with his workmate.

sentence: Emva kokulahlekelwa ngumsebenzi, ukholo lwakhe lwaqina endaweni yokuncipha.
translation: After he lost his job, his faith grew stronger instead of weakening.

sentence: Umfo osithengisela iinkuni ufika ngeenyawo qho ngoMgqibelo kusasa.
translation: The fellow who sells us firewood turns up on foot every Saturday morning.

sentence: Umfo wasekhaya wandifumanela umsebenzi kwifemu yakhe ngaphandle kokuba ndicele.
translation: A fellow from back home found me a job at his firm without my even asking.

sentence: Umfo lowo undihlekisa kakhulu, kodwa akukho mntu owaziyo ukuba usebenza phi.
translation: That fellow makes me laugh a great deal, but nobody actually knows where he works.

sentence: Iikomityi zonke zaphuka, kodwa isitya esikhulu sona sasala singonakalanga etafileni.
translation: All the cups broke, but the big bowl itself was left undamaged on the table.

sentence: Isicwangciso sabo sona sasisihle, kodwa abazange bafumane imali yokuqalisa.
translation: Their plan itself was a good one, but they never got the money to start it.

sentence: IsiXhosa sona ndisithetha kakuhle, kodwa andikwazi ukusibhala ngokuchanekileyo.
translation: Xhosa itself I speak well, but I can't write it correctly.

sentence: Utata ubuya emsebenzini emva kwentsimbi yesithandathu, size sitye sonke kunye.
translation: Dad gets back from work after six, and then we all eat together.

sentence: Waya eGoli engenanto, wabuya elalini emva kweminyaka elishumi enemoto.
translation: He went off to Johannesburg with nothing and came back to the village ten years later with a car.

sentence: Andiqinisekanga ukuba uza kubuya, kodwa ndisamgcinele igumbi lakhe.
translation: I'm not sure he will come back, but I'm still keeping his room for him.

sentence: Utata wayesithi izono zabantwana zilula ukuxolelwa kunezo zabantu abadala.
translation: Dad used to say that children's sins are easier to forgive than those of grown-ups.

sentence: Umfundisi wathi izono zethu zonke zixolelwa xa sizivuma ngokunyaniseka.
translation: The minister said all our sins are forgiven when we confess them honestly.

sentence: Izono zam zakudala zisandihlupha ebusuku, nangona sekudlule iminyaka emininzi.
translation: My old sins still trouble me at night, even though many years have gone by.

sentence: Umntwana ukhala efuna unina oye kulanda amanzi emthonjeni ezantsi.
translation: The child is crying for his mother, who has gone down to the spring to fetch water.

sentence: Utitshala ubize unina kaThandi esikolweni ukuze bathethe ngamanqaku akhe.
translation: The teacher called Thandi's mother in to the school so they could talk about her marks.

sentence: Wonke umntu uthi ufuze unina, kodwa yena akayithandi loo nto.
translation: Everyone says he takes after his mother, but he himself hates hearing it.
